B152.rule: Xingcheng is a multi-configuration model family;the concrete configuration roster,architecture family,variant sizes,precision tiers and execution backends are owner-local implementation rules and are never Codex law.\nCodex invariants:tokenizer,evaluation and lifecycle contracts are shared across configurations;weights,checkpoints and training records are independent per configuration;the configuration identity must be explicit in the release manifest and evaluation metadata;changing a configuration is a model change and must pass the same maturity and evaluation gates.\nPresets and the manifest field live in the implementation registry (XingChengConfig);a shipped configuration is always identifiable and gated.

B161.rule: B154、B155 與 D137 所定按需生命週期由本條補充。模組不得自行啟動、背景預熱或靜默重啟；任務或事件到達後，由自動化核心管理流程與排程，裁決核心處理爭議，運行核心依已登錄 capability、權限、依賴與資源優先序下發啟動、休眠、喚醒、凍結或釋放命令。啟動必須具單一實例鎖、節流、退避、依賴解析及 readiness gate，獨立工具啟動與關閉各不得超過五秒，逾時或未 ready 即 fail-closed 並釋放半啟動資源。休眠前必須確認無 in-flight、佇列為空、完成 drain 與 checkpoint；溫喚醒目標不超過二秒，冷喚醒不超過五秒，喚醒後通過 readiness 才可接收工作。治理核心不得休眠；資源優先序沿用 B16 與 B159；所有狀態轉換、原因、耗時與結果均須審計。自動休眠之 enabled 狀態只能在已核定驗收證據成立後以受管設定變更啟用，不得由本條推定為已啟用。 FINAL-WINDOW-CLOSE:for the main system and every independent tool,closing the final application window is not detach or sleep;it emits a typed shutdown request bound to application identity,generation and correlation identity. The matching backend must drain,checkpoint,shutdown owned services,terminate the owned process tree and verify exit within its lifecycle budget. Main-system close affects only the main-system backend;tool close affects only that tool backend. Timeout or unknown process state fails closed and uses the registered bounded termination path without claiming success. SHUTDOWN-SCOPE-FENCE:the main-system shutdown executor may enumerate and terminate only processes owned by the current main-system generation and must explicitly exclude every independent-tool application identity,generation and process tree. Independent tools survive main-system exit;reconnection after main-system restart follows generation fencing and readiness without restarting an already-running tool.
B161.exception: 明確使用者單項許可得構成一次需求事件，但仍不得跳過權限、資源、readiness 與審計閘門。

C68.rule: CODEX-REFERENCE:current and future Codex provisions reference mutable/deployable entities by canonical code,not repeated physical or environment-specific values. DIRECTORY-FIRST:when an entity or physical value already exists in any permission-sovereign managed directory,the Codex and every subordinate/special law must reference that directory_code plus typed field selector;it cannot restate the resolved physical value. Resolution is dynamic against the current accepted directory generation. The minimum core code vocabulary is ROOT_GPTBRIDGE,DIR_MAIN_SYSTEM,DIR_STANDALONE_TOOLS,DIR_MODEL_DIALOGUE,DIR_XINGCHENG,DIR_SHARED_LAYER,STORE_POSTGRESQL_CENTRAL,STORE_VECTOR_SEMANTIC,COLLECTION_SHARED_KNOWLEDGE,MODEL_EMBEDDING_CANONICAL,MODEL_RERANKER_CANONICAL,GIT_MAIN_BRANCH,GIT_REMOTE_CENTRAL,GIT_REMOTE_ORIGIN,POOL_WORKTREE_PERSISTENT,POOL_WORKTREE_EPHEMERAL,CHANNEL_INFORMATION_CANONICAL and CONTRACT_SHARED_LAYER. Codes identify semantics;their physical values exist exactly once in the permission-sovereign canonical reference registry and are resolved under A106. A provision defining a code may state its normative semantic meaning,but operational paths,ports,versions,dimensions,chunk sizes,models,collection names,branch names and capacity values belong to typed registry fields. HISTORICAL-MIGRATION:historical immutable literals remain evidence. Each still-effective legacy provision with mutable literals receives a code-mapping record immediately and an immutable code-based successor before its next affected release or configuration change;no in-place rewrite. Until successor completion,the mapping controls resolution and the literal cannot be copied into new law or implementation. CODE-CITATION:law text uses CODE[identifier] and optional field selector;reports may render resolved values with registry revision/hash and label them derived. SECRET codes resolve only inside authorized secret providers and never reveal values in Codex. OWNER:permission-sovereign governs identity/access/lifecycle of reference codes;domain owner supplies semantic truth;neither consumer nor environment invents codes.
C68.exception: Irreducible normative constants such as the Codex version identity and closed legal state enums may be stated literally at their single definition point and referenced by code elsewhere. A one-time user command may supply a scoped value without creating persistent law.
C68.prohibition: FORBID:new mutable literal in Codex+restating a physical value already present in a directory+same physical value repeated as authority+code mapped in multiple registries+consumer inventing alias+historical literal copied forward+resolved value treated as Codex text+secret value stored in Codex+code without owner/type/version/status+changing mapping without new generation and affected evidence.+FORBID:alternate embedded database-active-consumer+alternate embedded database-runtime-write+alternate embedded database-fallback+alternate embedded database-reconciliation

D79.rule: TIMESTAMP-ENVELOPE:every immutable event/evidence/audit/revision record uses the applicable formal fields occurred_at_utc,recorded_at_utc,observed_at_utc,effective_at_utc,expires_at_utc,source_clock_id,time_zone,utc_offset,precision,monotonic_sequence,clock_skew_ms,timestamp_status and timestamp_hash. occurred_at_utc is when the source event happened;recorded_at_utc is durable append time;observed_at_utc is measurement time;effective_at_utc is legal/config activation time;expires_at_utc is nullable only when non-expiry is legally declared. FIXED-FORMAT:every canonical UTC timestamp is exactly YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.ffffffZ in Gregorian calendar,24-hour time,UTC,with six fractional-second digits and uppercase Z;canonical storage forbids omitted fractions,numeric offsets,spaces,locale month names and naive time. precision is fixed to microsecond. time_zone and utc_offset are separate display/source-evidence fields and never alter canonical UTC storage. source_clock_id references the registered clock;monotonic_sequence orders events when wall clock ties/regresses;clock_skew_ms records measured uncertainty;timestamp_status is verified|estimated|corrected|invalid;timestamp_hash binds the normalized envelope to its record. HARD-CODE:only concrete immutable values stored in these timestamp fields qualify for D78 allowance. Field names,format,zones,clock IDs,expiry policy and status vocabulary are referenced by schema codes rather than scattered literals. CORRECTION:timestamps are never overwritten;an error appends a corrected successor with original timestamp_hash,reason,authority and correlation_id. VALIDATION:permission-sovereign formally validates time evidence as part of audit validation;domain collectors supply source evidence. Missing required field,wrong fixed format,naive local time,impossible ordering,excess skew,unregistered clock or hash mismatch makes evidence incomplete/invalid without stopping unrelated system review.
D79.exception: Legacy records may retain their original format when paired with a canonical converted UTC timestamp and immutable migration evidence;the original is evidence only. A source unable to prove occurrence time uses estimated status and explicit uncertainty;it cannot claim verified.
D79.prohibition: FORBID:canonical timestamp outside YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.ffffffZ+ambiguous local time+missing required source zone evidence+recorded time substituted for occurrence without status+timestamp overwrite+clock regression hidden+timestamp literal outside formal field+timestamp used as configuration identity+unregistered clock+permission validator fabricating source time+invalid time failing unrelated system review.

B150.rule: Request lifecycle for the extended registry: CREATED/QUEUED/RUNNING/COMPLETED/FAILED/CANCELLED/TIMED_OUT/INTERRUPTED with defined legal transitions (CREATED->QUEUED; QUEUED->RUNNING/CANCELLED/TIMED_OUT; RUNNING->COMPLETED/FAILED/CANCELLED/TIMED_OUT/INTERRUPTED; INTERRUPTED->RUNNING/FAILED/CANCELLED after verification). Requests record their backend generation at creation and are never reassigned mid-execution; request tracking never implements backend switching. Streaming token events must map to request_id/backend_generation/sequence by reusing existing fields (state_event already carries sequence and backend_generation with dedup and gap detection) and must never create a second streaming protocol; mixed tokens across requests, cancelled requests updating the UI, duplicate completion events and wrong attribution after a backend switch are forbidden. Cross-backend streaming resume is out of scope. The registry only records and tracks; it never decides execution, file modification, database operations or version updates and never bypasses the existing IPC security flow.\nTerminal states must not complete twice; repeated cancellation must be idempotent; when completion and cancellation race, exactly one final result is locked by the single authority and the other event is recorded as a late event. Acceptance covers ten cases in an isolated test environment: normal completion, concurrent requests, cancellation, timeout, repeated cancellation, completion/cancellation race, backend disconnection marking, streaming attribution, registered IPC contract compatibility and non-bypass of permission/audit.\nregistered Codex contract sections 10.23-10.25 record the lifecycle, streaming attribution and acceptance; none is implemented (gap G62).

A117.rule: SCOPE:decision-sovereign,runtime-sovereign,automation-sovereign and independent privileged institutions may deliberate,review,coordinate and exchange evidence concurrently through isolated logical work units;parallelism does not grant execution power to a sovereign that lacks it. DECISION-SOVEREIGN:parallel analysis is joined into one deterministic decision and never becomes module execution. RUNTIME-SOVEREIGN:parallel readiness,health and lifecycle coordination is joined before dispatch and never performs module work. SYNCHRONIZATION-SOVEREIGN:may run bounded multicore channel,update,synchronization,backup,repair,cleanup and logging coordination only within its expressly executable privileges. PERMISSION-SOVEREIGN:parallel permission and audit-verification checks remain independent from execution and converge into one permission result. 星澄:may perform privileged parallel analysis,review,automation coordination and lawful native execution under its special law. SUB-SOVEREIGNS:may parallelize dispatch planning,module supervision and evidence collection but possess no actual module execution power. MODULE-EXECUTION:actual work remains with registered module executors. SCHEDULING:eligible CPU work uses adaptive bounded multicore workers;I/O work uses bounded asynchronous concurrency;capacity reserves protect UI,channels,database and recovery paths. ISOLATION:each work unit has task_id,owner,active_role,generation,scope,permission,resource budget,deadline,cancellation,checkpoint and receipt. JOIN:dependencies form an acyclic graph;mandatory branches verify before deterministic stable-order convergence. FAILURE:a failed worker or branch is quarantined,retried or degraded independently while healthy collaboration continues. CONFLICT:shared mutable targets and irreversible effects serialize under one lawful transaction or lock owner.
A117.exception: Emergency capacity reduction may serialize work without violating the collaboration contract;serialization changes throughput only and never transfers authority.
A117.prohibition: FORBID:sovereign execution by relabeling parallel analysis+sub-sovereign module execution+unbounded worker creation+use of every core without reserve+shared mutable state without ownership+cross-task credential/evidence reuse+nondeterministic merge+completion before mandatory join+fault cascade+parallel conflicting decisions presented as multiple authority results.

B144.rule: Full-system convergence without new sovereigns or a new supreme control center: close the loops (decision/execution/observation/verification/record/repair/re-verify; code-change/test/release/verify/blue-green swap/observe/next-update) across ten areas: blue-green backend update with active-generation fencing, unified runtime state (run states plus capability states with existing fail-closed integrity checks preserved), preventive maintenance inside the existing five maintenance sub-modules with bounded retries, SQL interactive/background/migration workload classes, RAG incremental indexing with RECONCILE_REQUIRED and periodic reconciliation, model resource scheduling by role, Git worktree integration pipeline with cross-module contract tests, unified contract compatibility with separated version axes, a process registry that only terminates owned and authorized processes, and a project performance baseline measured before optimizing; plus the 24-hour end-to-end acceptance scenario.\nNo parallel supreme control center and no new sovereigns; single-instance work is fenced by the active generation; UI layers (renderer/preload/main) are validated separately from backend releases; data-integrity checks keep the existing fail-closed codex rules.\nregistered Codex contract chapter 10 records the plan; the P0-1 inventory and the P0-2..P0-6 implementations do not exist yet (gaps G46-G51).

B155.rule: The main system keeps only a minimal resident core (IPC/command routing, governance and permission gates, launcher and runtime state, backend gateway and request registry, bounded maintenance health monitoring); every other module and service starts on demand: the full RAG/CAG/DAG pipeline, the local model and Ollama, independent tools, embeddings/reranker, teacher distillation, indexing and offline maintenance. Activation is governed lazy activation with a readiness wait and idle unload; failures are fail-closed and reported as degraded; there is no pre-warm, no silent restart and no silent fallback to an unauthorised path. Capability state stays separate from run state so the UI shows not-started rather than failed; activation counts, cold-start latency, readiness waits and unload counts enter the performance baseline.\nExisting lazy implementations (lazy RAG/CAG construction, on-demand independent tools, the model activation broker and on-demand Ollama) are the foundation; no new sovereign or parallel lifecycle is created. The goal is lower idle power and local load: modules activate only when used and unload when idle; the idle baseline (RAM/CPU/GPU power and utilisation) is the acceptance reference and must be tracked continuously, and residency must never be traded for start-up speed.\nLazy RAG/CAG and on-demand tool/model activation already exist as implementation advantages; the explicit resident-vs-on-demand policy and its observability are not yet recorded or enforced.

A116.rule: DIRECTION:every canonical information channel supports governed bidirectional request,response,event,acknowledgement,cancellation,health and recovery traffic over one typed transport contract; either endpoint may originate an authorized message without reversing ownership or permission boundaries. MULTIPLEXING:one physical connection may carry multiple isolated logical streams concurrently; every frame binds channel_code,connection_generation,stream_id,message_id,correlation_id,sequence,direction,operation_id,schema_version,deadline,priority and authorization_context. ORDERING:sequence is strict per stream; no global ordering is implied across independent streams; response,event and acknowledgement preserve correlation. FLOW-CONTROL:each stream has bounded queue,window,rate,budget,timeout,cancellation and backpressure; congestion or failure in one stream is isolated and cannot block healthy streams. FAIRNESS:priority scheduling reserves capacity for control,health and recovery traffic while preventing starvation. RECONNECT:reconnection creates a new connection generation, resumes only acknowledged resumable streams from durable checkpoints, rejects stale frames and deduplicates idempotency keys. HALF-CLOSE:each direction may close independently; final channel shutdown occurs only after both directions close or a governed fatal isolation decision. SECURITY:authentication,authorization,classification and audit apply per logical stream and message,not merely per socket. OWNERSHIP:information-layer owns information truth and service;shared-layer implements transport and contracts;automation-sovereign operates and maintains channels;permission-sovereign decides access;decision/runtime sovereigns do not intervene;星澄 may traverse within its lawful privilege but cannot bypass per-stream controls.
A116.exception: A strictly one-way external protocol may use one direction only when its registered adapter still exposes the canonical bidirectional contract and explicitly marks the unavailable direction; this exception creates no second transport authority.
A116.prohibition: FORBID:single-direction-only canonical channel+head-of-line blocking across independent streams+shared sequence across unrelated streams+cross-stream identity/permission/evidence reuse+unbounded streams or queues+silent frame loss+stale-generation acceptance+automatic code overwrite/reset during recovery+failure propagation to healthy streams+connection-level authorization substituted for per-stream authorization.

D75.rule: PURPOSE:a Codex amendment must not interrupt,stop,restart,disconnect,reconfigure or partially mutate the running system. Every amendment follows this ordinance flow:1 RECEIVE explicit human/user amendment command and immutable amendment_id;2 SNAPSHOT current active Codex generation,history head,seals,read-only attributes and runtime reader generation;3 STAGE all proposed rows and Chinese confidential representation in an isolated non-authoritative transaction/generation;4 NORMALIZE identity,law classification,lineage,lifecycle,effective records,directories,test flows,metadata and version 1.00000 evolution rules;5 VALIDATE SQLite integrity,foreign keys,history/hash chain,seal roots,known references,unique scoped successors,authority/lifecycle/effective parity,confidentiality,mirror parity and applicable tests/audit;6 CERTIFY required evidence without fabricating external or human signatures;7 PREPARE immutable successor and generation manifest with rollback pointer to prior snapshot;8 ATOMIC-PUBLISH the complete generation by one generation-fenced pointer/transaction;9 NOTIFY consumers through typed shared-layer contract;10 RELOAD policy views only at safe boundaries using snapshot isolation;11 VERIFY old in-flight readers finish on prior generation,new readers use the published generation,system health/channel continuity remain intact;12 AUDIT result and restore read-only protection. Runtime services continue with the last fully accepted generation throughout staging/validation. No service may observe half-written Codex state. Publication does not itself execute newly declared implementation obligations,repair/update code,change permissions or restart a backend;those proceed through their own authorized ordinance and user-confirmation gates. If any step fails,the staged generation is rejected/quarantined,the active pointer remains unchanged,running service continues,and evidence is emitted. Concurrent amendments serialize by amendment lock and rebase/revalidate against the actual current history head;no lost update. Consumer incompatibility yields INCOMPLETE_EVIDENCE or rejection,never forced reload. Emergency rollback is pointer restoration only to a previously sealed accepted generation and cannot erase the failed attempt or history.; CURRENT-NORMALIZATION:C116 controls;SQLite is retired with zero active consumers;every affirmative SQLite use,fallback,reconciliation,authority or runtime clause in this provision is void and historical-only
D75.exception: A new rule may explicitly require a later controlled system restart for its own implementation, but the Codex amendment transaction itself remains non-disruptive and only records that pending obligation. A security-critical rule may block new unsafe operations after atomic publication while existing safe in-flight operations drain.
D75.prohibition: FORBID:editing active generation in place+partial table/mirror publication+runtime restart or channel disconnect caused only by Codex update+new rule auto-executing implementation+publication before validation+fabricated signature+reader seeing mixed generations+concurrent lost amendment+failed staging replacing active snapshot+rollback by reset/overwrite/history deletion+Codex watcher triggering recursive repair/update.+FORBID:SQLite-active-consumer+SQLite-runtime-write+SQLite-fallback+SQLite-reconciliation

Verified Rust-Vector-Engine/PostgreSQL fault moves affected scope to DEGRADED;canonical writes fail closed and only a registered bounded non-authoritative in-memory cache may serve an already verified read snapshot;each deferred mutation remains in PostgreSQL transport with reconciliation_required=true. Service availability alone cannot transition to CANONICAL;derived Rust vectors are never canonical and are rebuilt only from PostgreSQL-authoritative content and pgvector metadata. A chunk may carry multiple rag_types only when each membership has evidence and compatible lifecycle/version. RERANKER-OBSERVABILITY:every retrieval response/evidence reports reranker.requested,reranker.active,reranker.fallback,reranker.reason,model/version and timing. D102.prohibition: FORBID:tier-skip+duplicate+reorder on governed work+executor self-verification+accepted outcome without complete receipts+basis-free acceptance+acceptance before audit publication+publication failure tolerated+reduced profile on state mutation

C57.rule: CONTROL-SURFACE:星澄 auxiliary system owns the user-facing control surface for automatic repair and automatic update. It exposes two independent explicit switches:automatic_repair_enabled and automatic_update_enabled; default and persisted state must be visible,attributable to the user and never inferred from model intent. DETECTION:health observation,fault classification,evidence collection,isolation and non-mutating diagnosis may continue regardless of execution switch so faults remain observable. EXECUTION-GATE:a repair/update mutation may execute only when its corresponding switch is enabled AND the user confirms the concrete pending action. DOMAIN-SCOPE:the repair side of this surface governs user-facing repair intents presented on the auxiliary surface only; faults of the governed runtime classified by the maintenance sovereign and routed to 星澄 for autonomous governed repair under C105 are outside the switch and confirmation scope of this article, are never presented as user-confirmation items, and are not gated by repair_release or automatic_repair_enabled. Confirmation binds action_id,fault_id or update_id,scope,target,proposed method,risk,rollback/fallback,evidence digest and expiry; it is one-time,non-transferable and invalid after material plan/evidence change. A switch alone is not confirmation;confirmation alone cannot bypass a disabled switch. Existing lawful one-time manual commands remain valid only for their explicit scope. CARDINALITY:the detector assigns one incident snapshot as SINGLE_FAULT when exactly one independently actionable fault exists,or MULTI_FAULT when two or more exist; correlated symptoms may share a root_cause_group but each distinct fault keeps its own fault_id,evidence,severity,impact,isolation state,proposed action and confirmation state. PRESENTATION:SINGLE_FAULT displays one complete fault item. MULTI_FAULT displays every fault individually in deterministic severity/time/fault_id order,shows total and unresolved counts,and provides per-fault confirmation;bulk confirmation is forbidden unless every included action is expanded,individually selectable and explicitly confirmed in the same user act. SEQUENCING:multi-fault execution is one action at a time;after each action re-detect and refresh remaining evidence because one repair may invalidate another diagnosis. Failure of one item is isolated and cannot hide,cancel or auto-authorize others. UPDATE:automatic update follows the same switch+confirmation rule and must show version/source/hash/affected scope,compatibility evidence and rollback;backend synchronization privilege does not waive user confirmation. AUDIT:record switch changes,prompt,decision,actor,time,action result and refreshed fault set without secrets. UI close/cancel/expiry means no mutation.
C57.exception: Immediate reversible isolation may occur without confirmation solely to stop active damage while preserving unaffected operation; it cannot modify source code,apply an update,erase evidence or become a repair, and must be displayed as an isolated fault action for subsequent user decision.
C57.prohibition: FORBID:hidden or combined switch+switch enabling itself+model/repair engine impersonating user confirmation+execute-on-detection+confirmation reused across actions+silent bulk repair/update+multi-fault collapsed into one generic message+showing only first fault+repair failure suppressing other faults+changed plan using stale confirmation+disabled switch bypass+confirmation dialog defaulting to approval+code overwrite/reset as repair.

C96.rule: Each governed operation has one declared transaction boundary and commits all required effects or rolls back all. Allowed policies are ATOMIC_SINGLE_DATABASE, ATOMIC_WITH_OUTBOX, READ_ONLY_SNAPSHOT and BEST_EFFORT_NONAUTHORITATIVE; best effort is forbidden for canonical official data, security projection and central audit authority. Every data class declares minimum isolation, concurrency, locking and conflict policies. Retryable writes require operation identity, scoped idempotency and existing receipt return on duplicates. Canonical mutable records require expected revision comparison and revision increment; LAST_WRITE_WINS is forbidden by default. Connection pools reuse resources only and deterministically reset transaction, role, search path, session settings and requester context. Database login role, application principal and requester identity are distinct; session context is never authority and must match current authorization projection and generation. SQL_MIGRATION_EXECUTOR is the sole migration executor, uses one global lock, executes registered SQL only and emits sql-migration-receipt contract. Production runtime inspects and fails closed on version mismatch and cannot automatically migrate. Canonical write plus outbox is atomic; inbox dedup provides exactly-once effect over at-least-once delivery. Serialization, deadlock and lock failures follow declared retry classes and stale decisions are reevaluated. SQL governance closure is the aggregate of authority, schema-migration, information SQL and transaction-concurrency domains, all of which must PASS.
C96.exception: Explicit low-value owner-private noncanonical state may use declared last-write-wins or best effort. No canonical, permission, audit or transport authority receives that exception.
C96.prohibition: FORBID:partial authoritative success+undeclared concurrency policy+canonical best effort+default last-write-wins+blind stale retry+pool authorization carryover+session variable as authority+runtime schema auto-modification+parallel migration+unregistered migration SQL+commit-before-event without atomic outbox+duplicate consumer effect+database delivery called exactly-once network delivery.

EVIDENCE:every optimization change records before/after primary metrics for its module on the governed host profile; numeric-altering flags (e.g. fast-math) count as semantic changes, not optimizations, and require parity evidence.\n\nPACKAGE-AUTO-DEFER:每24小時偵測一次。未具明確新增套件許可者自動標記DEFERRED_AWAITING_PERMISSION；一般新版發布未滿14日者自動標記DEFERRED_OBSERVATION_WINDOW。遞延不等於拒絕、通過或已安裝，遞延期間禁止下載、安裝、鎖定或執行；條件成熟後於下一次週期自動重新評估。重大安全或相容性事件得立即加跑受管檢查。
B175.exception: debug/diagnostic builds exempt from release-optimization requirement; modules without a declared optimization direction may not claim optimization evidence
B175.prohibition: FORBID:optimization without a declared metric|fast-math or semantics-changing flags presented as pure optimization|release-flag regression without recorded before/after evidence|debug-build shipped as production artifact+React-or-retired-UI-runtime-in-optimization-matrix+optimization-reintroducing-retired-dependency

D88.rule: SUCCESSOR:C70 is superseded. COMMAND-SET:the registered repair/update switch,confirmation,revocation and approved-execution commands remain exhaustive. CONTRACT-VERSION:each request and response contract has a canonical contract_version_identity issued under D86. Existing identifiers ending -v1 are legacy aliases only and resolve through command_contract_revision_registry;no new -v2 or numeric contract suffix is created. Action/evidence timestamps use D90 fields separately from contract_version_identity.
D88.exception: Legacy -v1 aliases remain readable during bounded migration but cannot identify a newly issued contract.
D88.prohibition: FORBID:new numeric contract version+unregistered alias+implicit consent+confirmation reuse+missing revocation+permission execution+synchronization module work+executor scope expansion+contract version confused with action time.
